effects.message: Pekki called at three in the morning to talk about the meaning of life. It has none, apparently. You lost a night's sleep.
Big news at the Trokari: Pekki has been sober for a month and went cross-country skiing. The whole pub cheered. He almost smiled.
Matti saw you carrying boxes and helped without being asked. "That's what neighbours are for!" You saved hours.
Olli cornered you at the bus stop to explain his new app. It took two hours. It is a to-do list.
Olli "fixed" your computer while you were out. It now runs Linux. It's faster, and he will tell the whole village about it.
You split a pizza bill with Juho. By his spreadsheet you owe €{owed}. You only had a salad. You're still not sure how he did it.
Juho paid back the €20 you lent him in the spring, plus 37 cents of interest, counted out in coins. He wants a receipt.
Pellinen's pizza delivery came to your door by mistake. "Keep it," he messaged. "I ordered three."
Pellinen got a job testing games in Helsinki! He quit after one day. "The commute had no save points."
Somebody lifted your fat wallet on the way home. You lost €{lost}. Should have used the bank.
You found €{found} in an old jacket pocket.

then.message: You caught the flu anyway, but the shot kept it short.
Run down from all that work, you caught the flu and spent days in bed.

else.message: You caught the flu and spent days in bed. Half the village has it.

effects.message: Tax refund! €{refund} landed in your bank account.
Friends invited you to their summer cottage for the weekend. Sauna, lake, grilled sausages.
Your bicycle was stolen from the rack outside your building. Only the lock is left.
Your TV died during the hockey final. Unforgivable.
Your boss gave you a bonus of €{bonus} for good work!
Bad times: you were laid off from your job.
The neighbours threw a crayfish party. You sang drinking songs until 3 a.m.
A mosquito kept you awake all night.
You picked blueberries on Pirttisaari hill and sold the extra buckets.
A snowstorm! You spent hours shovelling, and the R train was cancelled anyway.
A brown envelope from Kela. You spent an afternoon on the phone queue to understand it.
Village talkoot! You helped paint the kylätalo fence. There was coffee and pulla.
An elk on the tracks near Hikiä. The R train stood still for an hour.
Grandma sent €50 in a birthday card, three months late.
A colleague called in sick and you covered their weekend shift. Overtime pay: €{extra}.
A pipe burst upstairs. You spent the morning with buckets while the landlady phoned a plumber.
The cottage apple tree is heavy with fruit. You sell crates of apples at the roadside.
Finland won the ice hockey world championship! The whole village celebrates in the Trokari yard.
The local paper ran a story about you and your work. Your mother bought ten copies.
Your classmates started a study group at the library. Your notes are much better now.
